ru_mteb.finding: GigaEmbeddings paper reports ruMTEB evaluation over 23 multilingual tasks and 69.1 average score; this is source/paper evidence, not LegalGraph Nexus legal-domain proof.

rusbeir.finding: RusBEIR introduces a Russian IR benchmark with 17 datasets and reports that neural models such as mE5-large and BGE-M3 perform well on many datasets while long-document retrieval remains constrained by input length.

policy.rationale: Human/project memory decisions require local/open-weight embedding evaluation only. Managed embedding services are out of scope; this task records candidate evidence and probe requirements without adding packages or invoking external embedding endpoints.

preliminary_recommendation.boundary: This is not a legal retrieval quality claim. Runtime encode, FalkorDB 1024/2048-dimensional storage, synthetic retrieval, and later real EvidenceSpan/SourceBlock evaluation remain pending.
preliminary_recommendation.rationale: USER-bge-m3 is the practical first local baseline because it is Russian-focused, 1024-dimensional, Apache-2.0, sentence-transformers-compatible, and avoids custom remote code. GigaEmbeddings remains a quality-first challenger because public model/paper evidence suggests strong Russian embedding performance, but it has higher runtime and storage risk: 2048 dimensions, custom code, flash-attn/GPU-oriented examples, and stricter package requirements.

runtime_probe_contract_for_followup_task.download_policy: Default probes must run in no-download mode and classify absent cache as blocked-environment. Download mode must be explicit and limited to open-weight Hugging Face model IDs in this contract.
runtime_probe_contract_for_followup_task.legal_quality_boundary: Synthetic fixture scores may compare runtime behavior but cannot prove Russian legal retrieval quality. Real legal-document claims require parser-produced EvidenceSpan/SourceBlock evidence in later slices.
runtime_probe_contract_for_followup_task.logging_policy: Use synthetic Russian legal-style fixtures only; do not log legal document contents, secrets, full environment dumps, or raw embeddings beyond bounded shape/dimension metadata.
